text.en:
Segregation and Disposition of the Property as Housing and
Relocation Sites. - The subject 1,551.1416-hectare property is hereby declared as
housing and relocation sites for government employees and informal settler-families
living in danger areas, respectively, to be subdivided and disposed in the following
manner: (a) 300 hectares for the Armed Forces of the Philippines [AFP]; (b) 300
hectares for the Philippine National Police [PP]; (c) 300 hectares for teachers; (d) 300
hectares for other government employees; and (e) the remaining 351.1416 hectares for
the informal settler-families living in danger areas whose homes were destroyed by
Typhoon Ondoy, and those who may be similarly situated caused by future
catastrophes.
+451.240 37
PGMA Holouram # 51210

Transfer, development and administration of property. - Within
thirty (30) days from the effectivity of this Order, the BSP and DOF shall execute the
necessary instruments to ensure the transfer of ownership of the 1,551.1416-hectare
property to the NHA.

Funding allocation. The NHA, as administrator of the housing site,
together with the Department of Budget and Management, shall secure the allocation of
a budget to implement this Executive Order, taking into account the funding
requirement for varicus activities to be undertaken in connection hereof, such as, but
not limited to, the establishment of a fund sourcing scheme to finance the project.
The AFP, PNP and the Department of Education (DepEd) shall provide
corresponding funds from their respective savings for site development cost and other
logistical requirements for this project.

Implementing Rules and Regulations. - An Executive Committee
composed of the General Manager of NHA as Chairperson and representatives from the
Department of Social Welfare and Development, HUDCC, AFP, PNP and DepEd, as
members, is hereby created to formulate the policies (i.e., qualification of beneficiaries,
lot pricing or payment scheme, etc.) for the effective implementation of this Executive

Separability. - Any portion or provision of this Executive Order that
maybe declared unconstitutional shall not have the effect of nullifying its other portions
or provisions, as long as such remaining portions can still be given effect.

Repealing Clause. - All executive orders, rules and regulations and
other parts thereof which are inconsistent with this Order are hereby revoked, amended
or modified accordingly.

Effectivity. - This Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 23rd day of October, in the year of Our Lord,
Two Thousand and Nine.
glove Mr. Array
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
